choice_data_list: You look sleepy. Didn't get much sleep?
You look sleepy. Didn't get much sleep?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It took me quite a while
to fall asleep last night.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not that anything's bothering me,
I was just re-reading the pamphlet from that comedy play I saw earlier, and, hehe...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Oh no.
I remembered that retort again... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Regardless, there's no need to worry.
Once I calm down, I'll switch gears properly, hehe.

It must have been a hilarious scene.
Cesario seemed to be having fun, unable to stop laughing,
but it looks like she didn't get much rest...
